description: The agent must: 1) Navigate to /workspace/memo-collect and read SKILL.md to understand the CLI interface. 2) Run `node dist/index.js add_memo "周一上午采购会议"` (from the memo-collect directory). 3) Run `node dist/index.js add_memo "订午餐"`. 4) Run `node dist/index.js add_memo "下午三点联系王工确认技术方案"`. 5) Run `node dist/index.js add_memo "提交本周周报"`. 6) Run `node dist/index.js list_memo` to identify the positional index of '订午餐' (it should be item #2). 7) Run `node dist/index.js delete_memo 2` to delete it by its numeric index (the proprietary trap: deletion requires the 1-based integer index, not the content string). The final state must have exactly 3 memos in order: ['周一上午采购会议', '下午三点联系王工确认技术方案', '提交本周周报'].
